claude.sample_unit: patients (primary cohort 3,525 plus cross-cohort test set 1,205)
models_evaluated: Contrastive deep learning (SupCon, NT-Xent, Batch-Hard Triplet with VICReg)

links.outcome: Internal versus independent cross-cohort AUPRC of GDM prediction models
links.effect: All 60 classical-model combinations achieved internal AUPRC 0.959-0.998 and collapsed cross-cohort to 0.180-0.266; contrastive models 0.167-0.216.
links.quote: All 60 classical-model combinations achieve near-perfect internal area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) (0.959--0.998) and universally collapse cross-cohort to 0.180-0.266.

links.outcome: Performance degradation from distribution shift and concept drift between cohorts
links.effect: Cross-cohort AUPRC collapsed to 0.180-0.266; OGTT concept drift d = 1.91 internally versus d = 0.36 cross-cohort; findings consistent with drift in P(Y|X).
links.quote: Overall, the findings are most consistent with concept drift in the conditional relationship $P(Y \mid X)$, for which source-only adaptation is insufficient in this setting.

links.outcome: Cross-cohort AUPRC after training with data from both cohorts (oracle mixed-domain)
links.effect: AUPRC recovered to 0.944-0.978 when training included data from both cohorts, indicating model capacity is not the bottleneck.
links.quote: In an oracle mixed-domain experiment (non-deployment setting), when training includes data from both cohorts, AUPRC recovers to 0.944-0.978, confirming that model capacity is not the bottleneck.

links.outcome: Model generalization to a new cohort/population
links.effect: Cross-cohort AUPRC collapsed to 0.180-0.266 (classical) and 0.167-0.216 (contrastive) versus internal 0.959-0.998.
links.quote: Contrastive learning mirrors the classical result: all cross-cohort configurations collapse to 0.167-0.216 AUPRC regardless of loss function or preprocessing.

unlisted_practices: CORAL domain adaptation for cross-cohort transfer (estimator-dependent effects, improved SVM by up to +0.079 but degraded gradient-boosted models)
Excluding OGTT (pre-screening mode) with MICE imputation and robust scaling
Contrastive representation learning for cross-cohort robustness

links.outcome: internal versus cross-cohort GDM prediction AUPRC
links.effect: Internal AUPRC was 0.959--0.998; cross-cohort AUPRC collapsed to 0.180-0.266 across 60 classical combinations.
links.quote: All 60 classical-model combinations achieve near-perfect internal area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) (0.959--0.998) and universally collapse cross-cohort to 0.180-0.266.

links.effect: Internal AUPRC was 0.959--0.998; cross-cohort AUPRC collapsed to 0.180-0.266 across 60 classical combinations.
links.quote: All 60 classical-model combinations achieve near-perfect internal area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) (0.959--0.998) and universally collapse cross-cohort to 0.180-0.266.

links.outcome: OGTT feature concept drift across cohorts
links.effect: Mean cross-cohort AUPRC was 0.228; best SVM 0.266; OGTT drift d = 1.91 internally and d = 0.36 cross-cohort.
links.quote: Within this collapsed range, excluding oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) (pre-screening mode) with Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) imputation and robust scaling emerges as the most consistent strategy (mean cross-cohort AUPRC 0.228; best single result SVM 0.266), a finding we trace mechanistically to OGTT's catastrophic concept drift (d = 1.91 internally, d = 0.36 cross-cohort).

links.effect: CORAL improved SVM full-feature AUPRC by up to +0.079 but degraded all gradient-boosted ensembles and every pre-screening estimator.
links.quote: CORAL domain adaptation produces a striking estimator-dependent interaction: it improves SVM cross-cohort AUPRC in full-feature configurations by up to +0.079 while degrading all gradient-boosted ensembles across all configurations and degrading every estimator in pre-screening configurations.

links.outcome: performance in a new clinical cohort
links.effect: Internal AUPRC was 0.959--0.998; cross-cohort AUPRC collapsed to 0.180-0.266 across 60 classical combinations.
links.quote: All 60 classical-model combinations achieve near-perfect internal area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) (0.959--0.998) and universally collapse cross-cohort to 0.180-0.266.

unlisted_practices: Use preprocessing configuration changes, SMOTE training augmentation, CORAL domain adaptation, or contrastive representation learning to mitigate cross-cohort distributional shift in GDM prediction.
